title: Pair validity on one block
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, with $x$ written as a prefix followed by bits $b,c$ and a suffix. Starting in the parser's initial scanning state with its input head at the position immediately after the prefix and empty output, the constructed machine after two steps has its input head two positions farther along. If $b=c$, it remains in the initial scanning state with empty output; otherwise it halts and outputs the single bit that is true exactly when $b=0$ and $c=1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ decomposes as a prefix followed by $b,c$ and a suffix
